about_the_game:
"Why's It Getting DARKER?!" is a first-person psychological horror experience set in the haunting depths of a vast, pitch-black ocean. You’re not just exploring — you're being watched.

Step into the boots of a lone researcher trapped beneath the waves, guided only by fading signals, a malfunctioning PDA, and the voices of artificial intelligence that may or may not be real. Each dive into the abyss brings new anomalies, unpredictable horrors, and increasingly disturbing discoveries.

  • Explore a massive, open underwater world with randomized horrors and evolving threats.

  • Encounter powerful bosses that can appear without warning — some rarely, some repeatedly — all deadly.

  • Use your camera to document creatures and uncover the truth behind this submerged nightmare.

  • Fight, flee, or photograph — but every action has a consequence.

  • No handholding, no second chances. Darkness is coming, and it’s alive.

Prepare to lose track of time. And your sanity.

content_descriptors.notes: Why It's Getting DARKER?! contains themes of psychological horror, frightening scenes, and violent encounters with deep-sea creatures. Players may witness disturbing visuals such as blood, creature dismemberment, and intense survival scenarios. While the game does not glorify violence, it includes aggressive behavior from enemies and occasional dark humor via the AI companion. Viewer discretion is advised due to the tense atmosphere and realistic creature behavior that may be unsettling for some players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Tested on low-end systems. Reducing resolution and shadows improves performance.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4–6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: For the best underwater atmosphere, enable post-processing and set shadows to high.

short_description: Descend into the abyss in this first-person deep-sea horror. Photograph hostile creatures, balance oxygen, and survive unpredictable ambushes—all while guided by a darkly sarcastic AI.
